collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — BEYOND THE HORIZON, EVENTS 081 to 130 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more speculative branching events continuing "Isola — Beyond the Horizon" (001-080), in the same format: EVENT nnn — TITLE, SETUP, choices A/B/C, two mutually exclusive outcomes per choice, and an optional "Content note:".

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: Watching sparks rise from a festival bonfire, a child wonders whether distant people make fire bloom in the sky.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Watching sparks rise from a festival bonfire, (name1), a child, wonders whether distant people might make fire bloom in the night sky like flowers.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A cautious villager wonders how anyone would keep such fire from falling on roofs.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A drummer imagines the booming sound and loves the idea.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A parent with a baby wonders whether the noise would frighten little ones and animals.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: Villagers toss handfuls of dry leaves into the bonfire to make sparks; it is not the same, but it is fun.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The village decides fireflies are the island's own fire flowers.

a1__fx.name: Outcome A1
a1__fx.text: The children imagine bursts of colored light overhead and spin with delight.
